preconditions.description: Input integers d and s are within the specified bounds (1 ≤ d ≤ 500, 1 ≤ s ≤ 5000).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (int(stdout.strip()) > 0 and int(stdout.strip()) % int(d) == 0 and sum(int(c) for c in stdout.strip()) == int(s))
postconditions.description: If a valid n exists, stdout is the minimal positive integer divisible by d with digit sum s; otherwise, stdout is '-1'.
